title: Earthquake Country Alliance, Bay Area – Earthquake Country Alliance
text:
Earthquake Country Alliance Bay Area (ECA Bay Area) is one of three regional alliances that comprise the statewide Earthquake Country Alliance, a public-private-grassroots partnership of leading earthquake professionals, emergency managers, government officials, business and community leaders, and others.
ECA is best known for coordinating the annual Great California ShakeOut earthquake drill and developing multi-sector educational resources.
Funding for ECA activities is provided by FEMA’s Building Science Branch as part of its support for the California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services Earthquake Program.
We encourage you to Join the Alliance.
The Haywired Scenario Exercise Toolkit is now available!
The Toolkit is designed for use by businesses, government agencies, non-profits, community groups, and other organizations to plan, lead, and learn from discussion-based exercises. It includes facilitator tools for a variety of themes and topics detailed in the Haywired Earthquake Scenario for a magnitude 7.0 earthquake on the Hayward fault in the Bay Area. It was created through the collaborative efforts of the California Resiliency Alliance, Earthquake Country Alliance, and USGS, with input from other partners.
 
ECA Bay Area Workshops:
 
ECA Bay Area Fall 2025 Workshop (Online)
This online workshop featured a Seven Steps to Earthquake Safety training, to learn key guidance for what to do before, during, and after earthquakes to be prepared to survive and recover. The interactive training was an opportunity for attendees to provide feedback about the messaging and to learn how they can lead the presentation in their organization, community or with other groups. Participants also learned about ECA opportunities and resources, and were invited to share updates about their activities
 
ECA Bay Area Summer 2025 Workshop (Hayward)
This workshop will include presentations about the advanced seismic design of Hayward City Hall and the City’s emergency management approach; updates from several state partners; an overview of Santa Clara County’s recent earthquake exercise; and ECA 2025 activities including ShakeOut planning – followed by a tour of the building’s seismic design.
 
ECA Bay Area Spring 2025 Workshop (San Jose):
Slides now available
Attendees of this in-person workshop learned about current research along the Hayward and Calaveras faults, recently published guidance for earthquake resilient homes and for retrofitting or repairing concrete buildings, and ECA 2025 activities (including information about the Mini Awards program). See full agenda with topics and presenters below.
 
ECA Bay Area Winter 2025 Online Workshop:
Recording and Slides now available
This workshop explored tsunami and earthquake hazards – including lessons from the Dec. 5 Cape Mendocino earthquake and tsunami warning, Marin County’s response and local hazards, plus ECA activities and opportunities in 2025.
 
ECA Statewide Fall 2024 Workshop (Online):
Recording and Slides now available
This workshop included presentations about potential new earthquake information tools and challenges with earthquake early warning, an overview of earthquake impacts on utilities and other lifelines and how to reduce them, and updates about how to request free ECA printed materials, mitigation materials, and more!.
 
ECA Bay Area Summer 2024 Workshop:
A Tale of Three Earthquakes
This workshop included presentations about the 2014 South Napa earthquake, a special screening of Quake Heroes (stories from the 1994 Northridge Earthquake), discussion of plans for the 35th anniversary of the 1989 Loma Prieta Earthquake, and how to get free earthquake education and mitigation resources. Plus we were able to go on a special tour of a nearby wine barrel storage facility to see how storage racks and policies were changed as a result of damage during the 2014 earthquake.
ECA Bay Area Spring 2024 Workshop:
Materials now available
This workshop at the Rossmoor Retirement Community in Walnut Creek included presentations about earthquake hazards in the area, key issues for life after a “HayWired” earthquake, an overview of Rossmoor’s emergency preparedness efforts, and how to get free earthquake education and mitigation resources.
ECA Bay Area Winter 2024 Workshop:
Materials now available
Discussions at the UC Berkeley Seismology Lab focused on “slow slip” and earthquakes on the nearby Hayward fault (with a visit afterwards at the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory), the Bay Area CERT Coalition, funding opportunities, and plans for the Loma Prieta 35th anniversary.
ECA Bay Area Fall 2023 Workshop:
Materials now available
The workshop included a debrief about this year’s ShakeOut, updates about Earthquake Early Warning and FEMA resources, overviews of ECA’s Mini Awards, and plans for the Loma Prieta Earthquake 35th anniversary.
ECA Bay Area Spring 2023 Workshop:
Materials available now!
Learn about coordination of non-profit response during disasters, support for resilience of affordable housing communities, updates about ECA Mini Awards and the HayWired Toolkit, planning for ShakeOut, a commemoration of the 20th Anniversary of ECA, and networking/sharing opportunities.
ECA Bay Area Winter 2023 Workshop:
Materials available now!
This workshop included an in-depth presentation of the HayWired Scenario Exercise Toolkit, this quarter’s Quake Break, an update of ECA activities and more!
